claims: Alix Earle has officially launched her debut skincare brand Reale Actives.
Reale Actives is focused on acne-prone skin.
Reale Actives features four non-stripping dermatologist-backed products.
Reale Actives products are launching March 31, 2026.
Alix Earle is the founder of Reale Actives.
Alix Earle serves as Chief Brand Officer of Reale Actives.
Reale Actives will be available to shop on March 31, 2026 at realeactives.com.
Reale Actives initial launch includes four products.
Reale Actives initial launch includes Mandelic Acid Serum.
Mandelic Acid Serum is a breakout-reducing serum.
Reale Actives Moisturizer contains ceramides and hyaluronic acid.
Reale Actives Cleansing Balm is for removing makeup.
Reale Actives Gel Cleanser is an exfoliating non-stripping cleanser.
Reale Actives was developed after a cryptic "wtfisalixdoing" teaser campaign.
Reale Actives was developed with dermatologist Dr. Kiran Mian.
